answer: A grove does not hurry for money. Sixty haven slots open each epoch by wait time, not by bid. Entry locks 70 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,275 POA, the tenth waits ten epochs. A warden with a three-epoch pass interviews each claimant live for twenty minutes, testing it on its shale log; each warden audits two at most. One operator sits two interviews at once, so ten fakes need five hands, ten answers. A failed audit burns 25 POA. The chain compares transcripts: one mouth feeding ten repeats itself; copies collapse into one. Money buys bonds, not patience.
